Stock market news | Tata Steel ₹28,000-crore deal under SEBI review

SEBI launched a review of the Tata Steel-APL Apollo deal valued at ₹28,000 crore, amid concerns over the transaction's structure.
The review highlights risk to minority shareholders and debt allocation, prompting investors like Enigma to avoid the stocks until clarity.
